reasons: § 12.4 as drafted is walk-away territory under NOSOLICIT: a one-way no-hire ('solicit, hire, or employ'), 24 months post-term, covering every Vendor employee, with the carve-out affirmatively negated ('regardless of how the employee applies'). Deviation classification is correct — it fails the fallback on multiple material terms.

The redline lands squarely on the fallback: mutual, solicitation-only (no-hire deleted), 12 months from the end of the individual's involvement, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with express general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.

The failed 'minimal edit' check (ratio 0.864) is acceptable here: the original clause is defective on duration, scope, direction and carve-out simultaneously, so a full replacement sentence is the smallest edit that reaches the playbook position.
Comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position and the internal conflict with § 12.3, and matches the required concise first-person-plural tone.
